from pathlib import Path


SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'api' / 'admin_scheduler_resync.py'
TEXT = SOURCE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def _section(start, end):
    return TEXT.split(start, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]


def test_unit_config_uses_global_system_type_normalizer():
    section = _section('def _get_unidad_config(', '# =============================================================================\n# VALIDACIONES')
    assert 'normalize_system_type(raw_sistema)' in section
    assert "sistema_normalizado == 'SOFTRESTAURANT'" in section
    assert "sistema_normalizado == 'MANAGEMENTPRO'" in section


def test_dry_run_normalizes_softrestaurant_pro_before_branching():
    section = _section('async def _ejecutar_dry_run(', 'async def _ejecutar_sync_real(')
    assert 'normalize_system_type(sistema_raw)' in section
    assert "query_source = 'SOFTRESTAURANT_REPORTE_TURNOS'" in section
    assert "'backend_contract_version': 'softrestaurant-turnos-v2'" in section
    assert "'system_type_normalized': sistema_normalizado" in section


def test_real_run_uses_same_normalized_system_contract():
    section = _section('async def _ejecutar_sync_real(', '@router.get("/resync/history")')
    assert 'normalize_system_type(sistema_raw)' in section
    assert "if sistema == 'SOFTRESTAURANT'" in section
